findingDetails.title: Phase problem statement counts twelve related READMEs where the packet's own fix set is eleven
findingDetails.case: A reader reconciling the phase scope from its own docs gets twelve related READMEs from the problem statement and eleven from the Files Changed table, the ledger sentence and the review target.
findingDetails.evidence: spec.md:63 vs implementation-summary.md:51 vs the product diff's 15-file list; origin sentence at 023 research.md:3; 023 Section 11 content rows F12-F23 span eleven docs.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Counted from the diff file list (15 diff --git entries) and both Files Changed tables; the twelfth flagged doc carries only the ruled version row F28.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reword to eleven related READMEs, or name the version-only doc explicitly if twelve is intentional.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If twelve is intended to include the version-only deep-loop README, a wording clarification closes it as a text fix.
